title: Machine Learning-Based Strength Prediction for Refractory High-Entropy Alloys of the Al-Cr-Nb-Ti-V-Zr System.
summary: The primary abstract reports fabrication of the nominated alloy and measured strength and ductility at multiple temperatures. This is physical material validation, not merely prediction accuracy.
organization: Belgorod National Research University; Hunan University
